title: Chain of Thought
description: Think step by step. Why it works.

title: Advanced Techniques
description: Prompt injection, multi-turn flows, edge cases.

title: The Anatomy of a Prompt
description: Build a prompt from its components — task, context, constraints, format — instead of writing a wish and hoping the model fills in the rest the way you meant it to.

title: Teaching by Example
description: Use worked examples to pin down format and tone in a way plain description can't — and learn how many examples actually helps before more stops mattering.

title: Getting Output You Can Use
description: Specify output format — not just content — so the result can be pasted straight into a spreadsheet, a form, or the next step of a workflow, instead of being reformatted by hand every time.

title: Making It Show Its Work
description: Get intermediate reasoning you can actually check, instead of a bare answer you have to either trust or re-derive yourself from scratch.

title: Improving a Prompt Systematically
description: Treat a prompt as something you test and revise with evidence, one change at a time, against a fixed set of your own hard cases — not something you fiddle with until it feels better.
